title: Lavatories.
officialText: Where lavatories are provided, at least 5 percent, but not less than one, shall be accessible. Where the total lavatories provided in a toilet room or bathing room is six or more, at least one lavatory with enhanced reach ranges in accordance with ICC A117.1, shall be provided.
